hotels.title: All-Inclusive Northern Territory Wilderness Luxury with Safari Bungalows, Gourmet Dining & Wildlife Safaris
hotels.description: There is nowhere quite like Bamurru Plains, placing guests inside one of Australia's most extraordinary ecosystems on the Kakadu floodplains. Set on more than 300sqm of private wilderness, this off-grid safari camp pairs understated luxury with extraordinary wildlife and immersive access to the remote Top End. Just 12 safari-style bungalows and retreats share exclusive access to the floodplains, with mesh-screened spaces that dissolve the boundary between inside and out. Enjoy daily guided experiences including airboat safaris, crocodile-spotting river cruises, open-top game drives, guided wilderness walks, birdwatching and sundowner experiences. An in-house chef prepares every meal, three per day, served at the lodge, with canapes and sundowners adding to the daily rhythm. Your stay includes unlimited free-flow drinks, including Australian wine, beer and spirits, while the saltwater pool offers a tranquil place to take in the wild surroundings.
